title: agropyron maritimum
intro: Agropyron maritimum, commonly known as Beach Brome or Shore Brome, is a perennial grass native to the coastal regions of Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron maritimum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
